label: <DEL> step of long sequences (L>=8)
explanation: Fires almost only on the delimiter step (99.6% of activation mass), and only when the sequence is long: L=9 (about 48% of L=9 delimiters, 67% of mass), L=8 (about 27%, 31% of mass), L=7 rarely (1.7%), and never for L<=6. It never fires in the copy phase. In the original phase it fires only very weakly and rarely, on the last original token of L=9 sequences. Which long sequences fire depends weakly and diffusely on content: rates are higher when early original tokens (especially the first two) are t, g, p, j, z or o. First token t gives 2.2x lift. No simple token clause improves F1 by more than about 3 points. Recall is high (0.96, mass 0.98) but precision is only about 0.37, so the feature is a thresholded, content-modulated length-at-delimiter signal.
